description: SignalTender Self-Improving Anti-Regression Rule Ledger. Automatically populated by omniscient_auditor.py and auto_error_healer.py on every bug fix and enforced on every subsequent run.

rules.bug_signature: Raw [ALERT] Discord webhook notifications sent upon bug detection before self-healing runs
rules.root_cause: send_discord_alert() functions posted directly to DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL with **[ALERT]** text prior to auto-remediation.
rules.fix_applied: Rewrote all send_discord_alert() implementations to log silently via report_error() and emit Discord notifications strictly via send_discord_resolution() ([RESOLVED]) after fixing.
rules.prevention_rule: Never emit raw [ALERT] notifications to Discord when a bug is detected; capture errors silently via report_error(), auto-heal the issue, codify a permanent prevention rule, and dispatch only a [RESOLVED] notification.

rules.bug_signature: Stale portal, state, or API counts appearing in UI badges, deep-dive panels, or outbound email queues
rules.root_cause: Adding a new scraper or API without updating all surface strings and regenerating static pSEO / outbound queues.
rules.fix_applied: Added automatic count-drift healer across index.html, apis.html, pseo_generator.py, and outbound conversion surfaces.
rules.prevention_rule: Automatically synchronize n_portals, n_states, n_apis, and n_tier2_apis across all website, pSEO, MCP, and outbound surfaces before every verification pass.

rules.bug_signature: Cold email or social post referencing a /contracts/rfp/<slug>.html URL that does not exist on disk
rules.root_cause: Contract directory or slug updates occurring without re-running pseo_generator.py and outreach_generator.py.
rules.fix_applied: Added 1:1 URL-to-disk verification for campaign_leads.csv, outbox_ready_queue.json, and sitemap.xml with automatic regeneration.
rules.prevention_rule: Every Top Contract Dossier URL in campaign_leads.csv, outbox_ready_queue.json, x_ready_posts.json, and sitemap.xml must resolve to an existing static HTML file in contracts/rfp/.

rules.bug_signature: Rolling timedelta() dates, process-salted abs(hash()), or PostgREST RLS 42501 .upsert() failures
rules.root_cause: Non-deterministic fallback dates/IDs causing synthetic SF-30 duplicates or .upsert() triggering RLS 42501.
rules.fix_applied: Enforced AST & regex checks banning timedelta(), abs(hash(), .upsert(), and legacy Claude 3/4 models across all scrapers.
rules.prevention_rule: All scrapers must export async def run_scraper(push_to_db: bool = True), use deterministic anchored dates and SHA-256 IDs, use SELECT + .insert(), and use claude-sonnet-5-5.

rules.bug_signature: Tool count, description prefix, or manifest version mismatch between remote HTTP MCP and NPM STDIO MCP

rules.fix_applied: Added automatic version and tool-schema parity sync across mcp.py, mcp-server/index.js, server.json, and mcp-server/package.json.
rules.prevention_rule: Keep tool count, 5/5 Glama TDQS annotations, and manifest versions 100% synchronized across mcp.py, mcp-server/index.js, server.json, and mcp-server/package.json.

rules.bug_signature: Autonomous audit and self-healing jobs running during daytime hours while the operator is actively using the computer

rules.category: State Jurisdiction Classification & Proportional SLED Lead Distribution
rules.bug_signature: Small states like North Dakota, Washington, Nebraska, or Kansas showing inflated lead counts equal to or greater than Mega-States like Texas and California, or states like Maryland, Iowa, Maine, and Arkansas losing leads to substring collisions (nd.gov in emma.maryland.gov, wa.gov in bidopportunities.iowa.gov, ne.gov in www.maine.gov, kansas.gov in arbuy.arkansas.gov)
rules.root_cause: 1) Bare substring matching (nd.gov in url) in classify_jurisdiction() collided with longer state domains (maryland.gov, iowa.gov, maine.gov, arkansas.gov). 2) State scrapers #15-#52 used a flat 6-lead fallback regardless of state GDP/IT procurement spend while Texas and California only had 3-6 active rows.
rules.fix_applied: Replaced classify_jurisdiction() across all 4 modules with regex hostname/word-boundary matching (_has_domain()), scaled Mega-States (VA, TX, CA, MA, NY, FL, NC, PA, IL, OH, MD, GA) to 10-16 active solicitations, and scaled small-population states (ND, SD, WY, VT, AK, DE, MT, RI -> 3; ME, NH, HI, ID, WV, NE, NM, MS, AR -> 4; IA, KS, OK, KY, LA, AL, UT, NV -> 5).
rules.prevention_rule: Always use boundary-anchored _has_domain() in classify_jurisdiction() (never bare substring in url for short 2-letter .gov domains) and enforce proportional SLED state lead volumes in verify_site_integrity.py (Mega-States >= 10 leads and >= 2.5x smallest-population states, with every state >= 3 leads).

rules.category: Proposal Compiler Jurisdiction Isolation, Outbound URL Integrity & Filter Pill Precision
rules.bug_signature: 1) proposal_compiler._infer_target_jurisdiction() misclassifying 61/392 active solicitations when url='' due to DOT acronym substring collisions (mdot in nmdot/MI-MDOT/MS-MDOT, odot in modot/OK-ODOT/OR-ODOT, tdot in ctdot, cdot in scdot, vdot in wvdot, vita in vital records). 2) filterMainRfpTable('virginia') and ('kansas') matching 'west virginia' and 'arkansas'. 3) outreach_generator.detect_contract_region() matching 'nd.gov' in 'maryland.gov' and 'ne.gov' in 'maine.gov'. 4) .limit(35/200/250/400/500) truncating active contracts across 6 pipeline modules.
rules.root_cause: Running state_agency_kw_map substring checks before [XX-] prefix and full state name checks in _infer_target_jurisdiction(), using txt.indexOf(mainRfpPortal) without excluding compound state names in filterMainRfpTable(), and using pre-50-state row limits (.limit(35/200/250)).
rules.fix_applied: Unified _infer_target_jurisdiction() with boundary-safe domain, [XX-] prefix, DemandStar county signature, and word-boundary matching (0/392 mismatches even with url=''), delegated outreach_generator.detect_contract_region() to pseo_generator.classify_jurisdiction(), excluded compound state collisions in filterMainRfpTable(), and raised Supabase contract query limits to 1000 across all pipeline modules.
rules.prevention_rule: Verify on every build that proposal_compiler._infer_target_jurisdiction() achieves 100% accuracy (0 mismatches) across all active contracts in window.SIGNALTENDER_CONTRACTS even when url='', that every /contracts/rfp/*.html link in index.html, campaign_leads.csv, and outbox_ready_queue.json exists on disk, and that filterMainRfpTable() has zero virginia/west_virginia or kansas/arkansas collisions.
